## Invitations

The outreach activity resulted in 240 attendances from 2352 invited people. This represents an attendance rate of 10.2. The figures indicate that participation was lower during winter, with attendance recovering in spring. The invitation total provides the basis for assessing the reach of the activity, while the attendance figure records the number of people who took part.

The attendance results should be considered alongside the method used to contact invitees. SMS was the main recorded contact route, supporting timely communication with those invited. The figures below summarise the contact activity and the follow-up provided.

## Contact

Of the invitations issued, 2013 were sent by SMS. No reminder messages were received by 0 people. This indicates that SMS was used extensively, while the recorded reminder activity was 0. Together, these figures provide a concise record of how contact was made and whether reminder messages were received.
